decisions.story_title: Ukrainian Hackers Raid Russia Naval Systems, Exfiltrate Data From 70 Projects
decisions.reason: Real cyber operation: Ukrainian hacktivists breached Russian naval databases and exfiltrated data from 70 projects. Significant geopolitical cyber conflict event.
Generic explainer article about Telegram fraud operations. No specific CVEs, no specific incident details, no actionable intelligence. Low editorial value for a security digest.
New coverage of RatHat trojan by SecurityWeek (Zimperium research). Same campaign as existing story; adds breadth from a new source.

New npm supply chain campaign: 10 malicious packages with millions of downloads, bypassing lifecycle-script protections. Different campaign from the other npm story (which hides malware in package code); this one targets runtime execution.
PAYLOAD ransomware GPO campaign, same incident as existing story (Kaspersky investigation of April 2026 Middle East manufacturing incident). Adds cyberpress.com coverage.

Rust project warning about social engineering campaign targeting team members and crate owners via video calls. Same DPRK-linked campaign as existing story; this is the official Rust project advisory.
PAYLOAD ransomware GPO campaign, same incident. GBHackers coverage of the same Kaspersky report.
September 2026 update breaking File History backup. Same update wave as existing story (audio breakage). Adds another symptom to the known Patch Tuesday issues.
Rapuncel infostealer using Microsoft-signed kernel driver to disable 145 security tools. Related to the ongoing Microsoft-signed driver abuse campaign tracked in this story.
ChatGPT ad tracking via cross-site cookies. Privacy concern, not a security vulnerability or attack. No CVEs, no exploitation. Belongs in a privacy digest, not a security threats digest.

decisions.story_title: Canva Enterprise Data Exposed Through Third-Party Canny Platform Breach
decisions.reason: Real third-party supply chain breach affecting enterprise customer data. Canva enterprise data exposed via compromised Canny feedback platform.
ANY.RUN analysis of RatonRAT: BAT scripts for execution, scheduled tasks for persistence, targets credentials. Same malware as existing story.
